title.narrative: IAVI Organization File and Annual Report

description.narrative: IAVI is a nonprofit scientific research organization dedicated to addressing urgent, unmet global health challenges including HIV, tuberculosis (TB), and emerging infectious diseases (EIDs). Our mission is to translate scientific discoveries into affordable, globally accessible public health solutions. Our vision is a world where everyone has equitable access to innovative vaccines and therapeutics. We do this in collaboration with public, private, and community partners to accelerate the development of new biomedical prevention candidates in areas where the need is greatest and there is no traditional market incentive. Globally, we have offices and laboratories across five countries and collaborate with a network of clinical research center partners on four continents. This includes leading academic and research institutions in India and sub-Saharan Africa — which have the highest infectious disease burdens globally. Together with our partners, IAVI conducts research and development and strengthens capacity to: 1) Design and test the next generation of HIV vaccine candidates. 2) Optimize antibodies for HIV prevention and treatment and enable future access. 3) Conduct TB vaccine development and advocate for funding for TB R&D. 4) Prepare for future outbreaks of EIDs that repeatedly spill over from animals to humans. 5) Enhance local manufacturing capacity for vaccines and monoclonal antibodies in Africa. 6) Support our partners to develop their own global health products. IAVI receives generous support from the following major funders amongst many others: PEPFAR, Gates Foundation, The Government of Japan, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark, EDCTP, The World Bank, Open Philanthropy, Serum Institute of India, KFW, The European Union, WELLCOME, BARDA, amfAR, The Research Council of Norway and CEPI. Our most recent annual report can be found here: https://www.iavi.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IAVI-2024-Annual-Report.pdf?mc_cid=ca59f75206&mc_eid=44f35d812fOur most recent financial statement can be found here: https://www.iavi.org/about-iavi/financials/
